name: Fuel Cell, Electrolyser & Hydrogen Materials
summary: Covers the membranes, catalysts and ceramic electrolytes of fuel cells and electrolysers, and materials for hydrogen storage and handling.

topics.name: Fuel-cell and electrolyser thermodynamics and efficiency
Proton-exchange-membrane fuel cells: Nafion membranes, Pt catalysts and gas-diffusion layers
Electrocatalysis: oxygen reduction and evolution reactions; catalyst design and platinum reduction
Solid-oxide fuel cells and electrolysers: YSZ, perovskite cathodes and interconnects
Hydrogen storage: compressed, cryogenic, metal hydrides and chemical carriers
Hydrogen embrittlement and materials compatibility for hydrogen infrastructure
Photocatalytic and photoelectrochemical water splitting materials
